name: Ridley
verdict: Ridley is Belgian Cycling Factory's bike brand; the company describes itself as 100% family-run. Nothing found.
note: Belgian bike maker (Beringen); Uno-X Mobility's bike partner, logo on the chest, the circular 'R' patches on the upper sleeves and on race shorts. Rating note: family-run private company, founder/CEO Jochim Aerts; no state link; no human-rights record found. Rated none.
